[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC bob-cli-fn[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Capture lists under a lone @file header[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]A capture item whose first line is only `@file` (or [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]`@file#section`) files each bullet below it as its own new task (or[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]section note) in that file. A trailing ` :` or ` ^` on a task [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]bullet, or on one of its nested bullets, opens a block-ID prompt [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]for that task with a default ID Bryan is likely to accept, and ` [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]:<id>` also links the task into today's daily note. Execution, [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]`capture-parse`, `capture-complete`, the dry-run preview, and Bob [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]Mac Capture always agree.[/#D7D7AF]
